class.name: GroundDebrisFlow3D
class.brief_description: A post-fire debris flow: the moving body, its bulking and its deposit.
class.description: Runs the debris flows that [WorldGround] announces (its [code]debris_flow[/code] signal: an outlet, a volume, the channel path downhill with its widths and burn severity). Each event becomes a depth-averaged flow on a corridor of cells along its path, held back by a Voellmy basal resistance (Coulomb [member voellmy_mu] plus turbulent [member voellmy_xi]) and the slurry's [member yield_stress], so it stops by itself where the ground flattens, as a fan. It is fed at the outlet by a triangular hydrograph (Rickenmann 1999), gathers loose bed along the burnt channel ([member entrainment], McDougall and Hungr 2005) and lays what stops as fresh slurry on the ground ([method GroundSurface3D.add_mud_deposit]), raised ground through [member terrain_deformer], or sediment where it runs into water ([method WorldWater.add_sediment_mass]). Small events whose outlets lie on a running flow's path within [member pool_distance] feed that flow instead of starting their own. [PhysXDebrisSurge3D] follows the front through [method get_debris_front] and [signal debris_front_changed].

method.name: advance
method.description: Runs every body [param seconds] at once in steps of [param step] seconds (tests and replays). While [member listen] is on, the node advances itself every physics frame.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes every body, moving or finished, and its mesh. Deposits already laid stay on the ground.

method.name: get_active_bodies
method.description: The number of bodies still moving.

method.name: get_body_count
method.description: The number of bodies, moving or finished. Pooled events share one body.

method.name: get_budget
method.description: The volume budget of the body that carries event [param event_id], in m³: [code]in[/code] (fed at the outlets), [code]entrained[/code] (gathered from the bed), [code]out[/code] (run off the corridor's end), [code]now[/code] (in the body) and [code]time[/code] (seconds run). [code]now + out[/code] equals [code]in + entrained[/code].

method.name: get_debris_front
method.description: The front of the body that carries event [param event_id]: [code]position[/code] (on the flow's surface, only while the front is wet), [code]path_index[/code] (float index along the event's path), [code]depth[/code] (m), [code]speed[/code] (m/s), [code]width[/code] (m), [code]volume[/code] (m³ in the body) and [code]done[/code]. An unknown id returns only [code]done[/code] true.

method.name: get_deposit_depth_at
method.description: The depth of debris laid at [param position] by finished bodies, in metres.

method.name: get_flow_velocity_at
method.description: The depth-averaged velocity of the running flow at [param position], in m/s. Zero where no flow runs.

method.name: get_flow_depth_at
method.description: The depth of debris flowing at [param position] now, in metres.

method.name: get_volume
method.description: The volume in the body that carries event [param event_id] now, in m³.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts a body from an event [Dictionary] with the keys of the [code]debris_flow[/code] signal ([code]id[/code], [code]position[/code], [code]volume[/code] in m³, [code]path[/code], [code]widths[/code], [code]severity[/code]), or feeds it into a running body whose path passes within [member pool_distance] of its outlet.

members.member: The size of the flow's cells, in metres.
The width of the corridor of cells along the path, in metres. Wider lets the fan spread further.
McDougall and Hungr's growth rate E, per metre of travel, scaled by the path's burn severity. 0 keeps the volume as fired.

How high the levees a finished flow leaves along its margins stand, as a share of the deepest flow there (Johnson et al. 2012). Volume is kept: the levees take it from the rest of the deposit. 0 lays no levees.
Starts a body for each [code]debris_flow[/code] event of the active [WorldGround] and advances bodies every physics frame.
The deepest the flow can scour the bed, in metres.
How close a new event's outlet must lie to a running body's path to feed that body, in metres. 0 gives every event its own body.
The running flow shoves [RigidBody3D]s it reaches with a drag of [code]density * 1.2 * width * depth * u² / 2[/code] on their speed relative to the slurry.
Draws each body's surface as a mesh.
An optional [TerrainDeformer3D] that the deposit raises.
Runs the flow faster (above 1) or slower than real time.
The Coulomb friction coefficient of the Voellmy resistance, about the tangent of the slope it stops on.
The turbulent coefficient of the Voellmy resistance, in m/s². Lower values slow fast flows more.
The slurry's yield stress, in pascals. Thin layers below it stop.

signal.name: debris_flow_finished
signal.description: Emitted once the body carrying [param event_id] has stopped and laid its deposit. Pooled events get it too.

signal.name: debris_flow_started
signal.description: Emitted when event [param event_id] starts a new body.

signal.name: debris_front_changed
signal.description: Emitted once per physics frame (or [method advance] call) while the body carrying [param event_id] moves; read [method get_debris_front]. Pooled events get it too.
